pages.text: Using Aging Cream and some magic, you can artificially cultivate an Immortal Embryo, allowing it to grow into the apex predator of the Abyssal Chasm.

These voracious marine leviathans swallow the creatures they hunt—even submarines. Creatures killed by a Hullbreaker do not drop loot; instead, it is stored within their bodies. To retrieve the loot, you must feed them Henbane Flowers, Nightshade Blossom, or Poisonous Potatoes to make them spit the items back out.

Just like another interdimensional predator, you can right-click the Hullbreaker while holding fish, Glow Ink Sacs, or Bioluminescence to heal it. When the owner wears Abyss Robe, the Hullbreaker also passively regenerates health over time.
When a Hullbreaker is slain, it returns an Immortal Embryo. If Goety Cataclysm installed, you can also summon a Hullbreaker through a different ritual.
